intro: They say there's a second Istanbul, hidden beneath the first.
cistern: The Basilica Cistern. Built in the sixth century, with three hundred and thirty six columns. A water palace bigger than a football pitch.
hagia: In 2005, robot cameras lowered under Hagia Sophia found eight wells and a hidden room. About seven hundred metres of tunnels have been measured so far.
legend: Legend says these tunnels run to Topkapi Palace, even under the sea to the islands. In reality, most are water and air channels. A nine kilometre network? It's never been measured.
yenikapi: In Yenikapi, a metro dig uncovered a Byzantine harbor with thirty seven shipwrecks. And below it, footprints eight and a half thousand years old.
